notes.title: Hero Extra Life Changes, other misc changes
notes.notes: Many thanks to everyone who played Echoes of Egypt at AnimeFest Dallas last week!  Those play sessions resulting in several small difficulty and quality-of-life tweaks in this patch.

notes.title: Release v1.2.1 Performance
notes.notes: This update provides improvements in the appearance of the hero, as well as a significant performance boost.  Echoes of Egypt is now fully compiled from C++ source code instead of the slower .NET version.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes.
notes.notes: A handful of very small fixes.

notes.title: DreamHack Content minor Update v1.1.0
notes.notes: This brings the game up-to-date with the version shown at DreamHack, including the boss fight with Hathor in human form.  Various difficulty adjustments were also made based on player experiences.
